snippet.title: How I create a Custom Counter
snippet.description:
How I  create custom nodes in DaVinci Resolves Fusion that will generate Counters for you.
Instead of creating a counter each time from scratch, we will create one macro that does it for us.

Just follow the few steps, and you never have to animate a counter again.



--- Code ---

:
number = Counter
delimiter = Separator.Value
prefix = Prefix.Value
suffix = Suffix.Value 
; 

left,num,right=string.match(number,'^(.-%d)(%d*)(.*)'); 

return prefix..left..(num:reverse():gsub('%d%d%d','%0'.. delimiter):reverse())..right..suffix
